description: The September 8th Larchmont-Mamaroneck Local Summit kicked off its programming year with State Senator Shelley Mayer and Assemblyman Steve Otis providing a wide-ranging update on state legislative and policy developments. The program drew a large audience of residents and elected officials, including Congressman George Latimer. View Full Article >>
